traceability: Actual E28/P03 native board/BOM/filled-copper hashes, exact STEP/drawing/configuration hashes and measured assembled terminal-plane coordinates
Copper stock alloy/temper and conductivity certificate, critical bare-copper section measurements, plating provider/lot/thickness/adhesion/finish process
Original approved Würth terminal drawing, actual usable thread depth and tolerance, land/stencil/reflow/cleaning process and assembly lot
MCAM Ketron1000 natural unfilled PEEK material/lot certificate, machined threads, seat/cap metrology, actual fastener dimensions and calibrated torque tools
Instrument ID, calibration, positive expanded uncertainty and tested source/load/temperature/time/service-cycle conditions

required_measurements.limit_basis: Project allocation, not a manufacturer guaranteed contact resistance
required_measurements.acceptance: Each entire bar contact/stud/solder-to-PCB assembly measured resistance plus positive expanded uncertainty<=0.35mOhm. Define Kelvin planes at bar bulk and actual board return-access copper; reverse current to remove thermal EMF. Measure at declared operating temperatures and loads, after assembly torque, thermal cycling, vibration/service and reassembly.

required_measurements.limit_basis: Project allocations;1D geometry/resistivity screen excludes3D current crowding
required_measurements.acceptance: Measure actual finished bar with defined terminal reference planes, temperature and uncertainty. Inspect minimum bare-copper normal section at hole necks, bends and machined ramps; coating cannot silently substitute for copper core. Confirm conductivity certificate and maximum plating envelope.

Measure between actual operating board return reference planes including both terminal assemblies, copper bar and connected PCB return access; measured plus expanded uncertainty<=2mOhm. Suballocation sum is not an assembled physical pass.

Verify received thread engagement/clearance, washer and head dimensions, contact-face flatness and selected tin process. Use a separate temporary holding/support fixture so tightening torque does not load the SMT solder joint or3mm PEEK stem. Define allowable operating force/moment and service/vibration/thermal-cycle profile before qualification; limits remain open.
required_measurements.general_tolerance_basis: Wurth001.004 invokesDIN ISO2768-1m; exact application and solder seating allowance require approval

required_measurements.acceptance: Measure actual terminal planes and machine matched copper rise/retainer seat heights; no forced correction of P03 plane6.3..6.7. Verify gap with positive uncertainty, stem/PCB/floor clearances and cap slip allowance at dimensional and temperature corners. Test PEEK thread pullout, creep and repeated service; indicative material properties are not guaranteed thread or life limits.

Characterize the actual dogleg compliance, terminal/PCB motion and restrained thermal expansion in the complete assembly. Verify that motion does not overload soldered studs, bind the PEEK channel or cause contact slip/fretting and resistance drift. A fully restrained elastic screen is not a predicted actual assembly force; missing load/life limits prevent stability qualification.

Verify separate ANA/DIG bars and floating CHASSIS isolation, PEEK condition and absence of fastener/live-copper contact after aging/service. Establish system insulation limits. Measure ground bounce, switching-current coupling, rail transients, audio noise and susceptibility in actual operating cable/ground configurations; DC area/resistance does not establish RF/noise performance.
